title: Concept: Poetry resolves every package against an extra supplemental index
description: pyproject.toml declares a Poetry source marked `priority = "supplemental"`, which is searched for every package name, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A package published to the supplemental index can win over the reviewed one for any name the project uses, which is the dependency-confusion path.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pyproject.toml (pypi).
risk: A package published to the supplemental index can win over the reviewed one for any name the project uses, which is the dependency-confusion path.
